g.text: Text thresholds: long input ≥2,730 tokens (p90); short input ≤790 tokens (median). Panel D includes all current input lengths.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526171

g.text: Reuse uses strictly earlier arrivals and full 16-token blocks; partial blocks are excluded. Parent components follow observed parent links.

g.text: No completion times, cache-residency measurements, or latency measurements. Co-occurrence does not establish queueing. pp = percentage points.
